headline: Shradha Realty Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Shradha Realty Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares by a party; the filing does not disclose the acquirer identity, acquisition price, or stake percentage in the primary source.
detail: Shradha Realty Limited, listed on NSE, has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the exchange as mandated by SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when a person (alone or in concert) acquires or agrees to acquire shares exceeding specified thresholds. The NSE filing is dated 6 May 2026 and disclosed on 16 June 2026. The primary source does not provide the acquirer name, acquisition price, stake acquired, or transaction structure; these details are typically contained in the detailed Detailed Outcome Report (DvR) filed by the company with the exchange.
